gv_SqlDualSubscribers.defaultValue:
'WITH Invoice AS ( 
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        i.MEME_HICN,
        i.SBSB_ID
    FROM FACETS.CDS_INID_INVOICE i 
    WHERE i.GRGR_ID = 'TNMCR000'
        AND EXISTS ( 
            SELECT DISTINCT 1  
            FROM AGP.BOSS_INVOICE_LOOKUP l 
            WHERE i.GRGR_ID = l.GRGR_ID 
                AND i.BLBL_DUE_DT BETWEEN l.GRGR_EFF_DATE AND l.GRGR_TERM_DATE
        )
        AND  TRUNC(i.BLIV_CREATE_DTM) = TO_DATE('1/10/2016', 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM')  
) , 
DualMembers AS ( 
    SELECT m.MEME_HICN 
    FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP g 
    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC s
        ON g.GRGR_CK = s.GRGR_CK 
    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER m 
        ON s.SBSB_CK = m.SBSB_CK
    WHERE g.GRGR_ID IN ( 
         'TNMCR000', 
         'TNMCD000'
    )
        AND m.MEME_HICN IS NOT NULL  
        AND  (
                 m.MEME_HICN != ' '
                    OR m.MEME_HICN != ''
        )
    GROUP BY m.MEME_HICN 
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.GRGR_ID) > 1
) 
SELECT 
    i.SBSB_ID, 
    'TNDUAL00' AS GRGR_ID
FROM Invoice i 
INNER JOIN DualMembers dm 
    ON i.MEME_HICN = dm.MEME_HICN'
